business_summary.text: Hikal Limited is a diversified pharmaceutical and chemical company with businesses in Pharmaceuticals, Crop Protection, Animal Health, and Personal Care segments.

corporate_actions.subject: Annual General Meeting/Dividend - Rs 0.60 Per Share

operating_notes.text: Pharma capacity utilization at 55-60% during Q1FY27, impacted by planned shutdown for FDA remediation
Animal Health business has healthy volume growth across API and intermediate segments with repeat NCE campaign orders from leading innovator
Crop Protection CDMO export demand subdued with certain customer orders deferred to subsequent quarters

holders.name: TATA MUTUAL FUND - TATA SMALL CAP FUND

timeline.summary: Hikal Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 06, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹403 Cr and guiding FY27 revenue growth at 14-16% with EBITDA growth at 25-30%.

watchlist.response: FDA remediation costs are depressing EBITDA margins this year, but margins will improve significantly once remediation is complete by end of FY27
watchlist.text: Impact of FDA remediation costs on current profitability

watchlist.response: Margins remain under pressure due to Chinese competition, but volume recovery is expected in H2FY27 with gradual improvement in operating leverage
watchlist.text: Pricing pressure in Crop Protection business due to Chinese competition
